intended_distribution_profile: Official Canadian geospatial context that may be redistributed and adapted inside the local agent. Every bundled layer must retain record-level licence evidence, raw hashes, derivation metadata, source scale, and field-truth boundaries.

national_soil_context_gate.required_scope: Cropland in every Canadian province where annual, perennial, horticultural, orchard, vineyard, forage, or pasture production occurs, plus a spatial buffer around the agricultural mask.
national_soil_context_gate.detailed_overlay_policy: Detailed and thematic surveys may ship as explicitly regional overlays, but they do not satisfy or substitute for the national soil-context gate.

candidate_national_prior.product_role: modelled national screening prior with pixel uncertainty, never field truth
candidate_national_prior.mask_policy: Union of recent AAFC Annual Crop Inventory crop classes and the AAFC 2020 land-use agricultural classes, buffered 500 metres and tiled by province.
promotion_gates: all required provinces have nonempty agricultural-mask coverage
every tile has source version, checksum, units, depth, quantile, nodata, and licence lineage
field queries return uncertainty and mapped-prior boundaries
retrieval A/B shows incremental utility on frozen spatial agronomy cases without increasing unsupported prescriptions
portable size and cold-query latency remain within the edge-runtime budget
